description:
Record time worked against a thread, billable or not, and report totals.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD [DESCRIPTION ...] [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — add a time entry
  list [THREAD] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread T] [--since DATE] [--until DATE] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CCY] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change one field of an entry
  rm ID -y — permanently delete an entry

Args:
  THREAD       thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  DESCRIPTION  short invoice line-item label. One or more elements; they are joined. Must not be empty.
  ID           the entry's 8-character id, from `list`

Flags:
  log:
    -m, --minutes MIN   duration in minutes; must be positive (default 60)
    -r, --rate RATE     hourly rate; 0 = unbillable. Requires a currency.
    -c, --currency CCY  ISO code (default: the thread's currency). With neither, the entry is unbilled.
    -d, --date DATE     YYYY-MM-DD (default today)
    -t, --time HH:MM    start time (default now)
  list / report:
    --since DATE / --until DATE   inclusive window
    --thread T          (report only) one thread
    --json              JSON output
  show:
    --json              JSON output
  edit:
    --description TEXT  new description
    -m, --minutes MIN   new duration; start time unchanged
    -r, --rate RATE     new rate; requires a currency
    -c, --currency CCY  new ISO currency
    -d, --date DATE     move to this day; duration kept
    -t, --time HH:MM    move to this start time; duration kept
  rm:
    -y, --yes           required to confirm

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "DORA metric validation", "-m", "180"]
  ["log", "Topics/Fitness", "5k run", "-m", "30", "-d", "2026-09-30"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--until", "2026-09-30", "--json"]
  ["edit", "1a2b3c4d", "-m", "90"]

Notes:
  Keep descriptions short: they print on client statements, and `search` does not index them. Record narrative with `buffer add-text`.
  log also queues a REF: in the buffer, filed under the entry's date. It reaches the thread's daily log on the next `buffer flush`.
  Nothing prompts. rm is destructive and refuses to run without -y.
  Exit 1: empty description, minutes not positive, or a rate without a currency.
